title: MultipleScatteringCalculations: elastic multiple scattering from cubic heterogeneities
description: Code, symbolic derivations and validation scripts for elastic multiple scattering from cubic heterogeneities by the T-matrix method: the single-site T-matrix of a cube, the inter-site Green's tensor, and the Foldy-Lax multiple-scattering solve. The Python package (cubic_scattering/) implements the numerical schemes; the Mathematica notebooks (Mathematica/) derive the formulation symbolically; the scripts (scripts/) are the validation gates. This archive accompanies the paper 'The continuum limit of a space-filling layer of cubes: a tiling identity, an exact lattice kernel and the closed-form error of the discrete layer' (LatexPDFs/ContinuumLimit/), whose results are reproduced by Mathematica/ContinuumLimit_*.wl, Mathematica/CubeMomentCore.wl, Mathematica/CubeA22Block.wl, Mathematica/CubeShearSplit.wl, Mathematica/SphereClosureDynamic.wl and the scripts named in the paper's data-availability statement.
